stories.title: Board marks and computer tests proposed for NEET
stories.summary: A government task force is considering incorporating class 12 board marks into NEET rankings and shifting to computer-based testing. The proposal was discussed with state officials to address exam reform. The task force is currently seeking opinions on the future conduct of the national entrance test.

stories.title: NTA prepares for potential NEET digital shift
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency is launching offline computer-based test drills and a revamped mobile app to prepare medical aspirants for a potential digital or hybrid exam model in 2027. The initiative aims to support students in non-metro regions who may lack regular access to computer hardware.

stories.title: NTA simplifies NEET re-exam admit card access
stories.summary: Nearly 16 lakh candidates have downloaded admit cards for the June 21 re-examination. The National Testing Agency removed a mandatory bank account verification step that previously hindered access for some students. The agency released the updated hall tickets on June 14 to facilitate the process.

stories.title: Nationwide security drill held for NEET re-exam
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency conducted a nationwide mock drill involving 2.5 lakh security personnel ahead of the June 21 re-examination. Every test centre is now under agency control, featuring a three-layer security arrangement to oversee the transport and storage of question papers. The exam remains a logistical exercise.

stories.title: Tutorial institute announces entrance test for 2027
stories.summary: Saraf’s Ajinkya Tutorials has scheduled an admission entrance test for November 22, 2026. The exam is open to class 10 students aiming for engineering careers through JEE and MHT-CET. It will assess understanding of mathematics, physics and chemistry to determine eligibility for the 2027 to 2029 session.

stories.title: JEE Main 2027 registration exceeds 12 lakh
stories.summary: Over 12.23 lakh candidates have registered for JEE Main 2027 Session 1, with 10.10 lakh completing fee payments. The regular application window closes on November 22, 2026. A late fee period follows until November 26, with an additional charge of 500 rupees for those who missed the deadline.

Judge blocks limits on international student training
stories.summary: A federal judge blocked directives that restricted the types of training opportunities available to international students. The Department of Homeland Security had attempted to limit federal curricular practical training to programs required for graduation. The ruling maintains the previous policy allowing students to participate in any for-credit training.

stories.title: Court strikes down four-year student visa limit
stories.summary: A federal judge vacated a Department of Homeland Security rule that would have capped initial stays for international students at four years. The court ruled the policy was arbitrary and an abuse of discretion. The decision preserves the longstanding duration of status policy for visa holders.

stories.title: Federal ruling preserves student visa duration
stories.summary: A federal judge struck down a rule that would have limited international student stays to four years. The decision preserves the duration of status policy, allowing students to remain in the country until their academic programs are complete. The ruling supports continued academic flexibility for visa holders.

stories.title: US Court Scraps the 4-Year Limit on Student Visas: What F-1 Students and Applicants Need to Know - Telegraph India
Court rejects fixed stay limits for student visas
stories.summary: A federal district court struck down a regulation that sought to introduce fixed stay limits for foreign students and exchange visitors. The judge ruled the regulation violated the Administrative Procedure Act and exceeded congressional intent. The decision provides relief for those currently holding F, J and I visas.

stories.title: Trump administration loses again: Court reverses limits on international student visa duration - Daily Cal
Judge blocks restrictions on student work opportunities
stories.summary: A federal judge issued an injunction barring the Department of Homeland Security from enforcing directives that restricted internships for international students. The August mandates had disrupted training opportunities nationwide. The court ruling prevents the administration from enforcing the new limits on practical training for foreign students on visas.

stories.title: Irish universities report tuition losses from visa refusals
stories.summary: Four Irish universities expect to lose over 8 million euros in tuition revenue for the 2026-27 academic year due to a rise in visa refusals for Indian applicants. The financial impact was disclosed to the national broadcaster. Students with confirmed admissions remain unable to attend their courses.

stories.title: Visa refusals impact Irish university revenue
stories.summary: Rising visa refusals for Indian students have left four Irish universities facing a projected 8 million euro loss in tuition fees for the 2026-27 academic year. The decline in successful visa applications has created uncertainty for postgraduate programmes that rely on international enrolment. The situation remains a financial hurdle.

stories.title: UK visa interviews result in 80% rejection rate
stories.summary: A UKVI briefing paper shows 9,043 of 11,415 students interviewed between May and October were deemed non-credible. Rejection rates for interviewed students reached 92% for Nepalese applicants and 89% for Indian applicants. The Home Office noted the data covers only a six-month period.

stories.title: UK student visa applications drop 31%
stories.summary: Sponsored study visa applications fell to 5,800 in October 2026, down from 8,400 in October 2025. The decline follows uncertainty in the international education market and the announcement of a proposed 925 pound annual levy on international students starting in August 2028.

stories.title: Madhya Pradesh offers fee support for meritorious students
stories.summary: The Government of Madhya Pradesh operates the Mukhyamantri Meritorious Student Scheme to provide up to 1.5 lakh rupees in financial assistance for higher education. The scheme covers various undergraduate programmes, with eligibility determined by school marks and family income limits of 6 lakh rupees.

stories.title: Confederation College awards 13,000 dollars to international students
stories.summary: Confederation College presented three international students with 13,000 dollars in entrance awards on November 13. The recipients, Olanrewaju Nathaniel Mustapha, Nayiwei Che and Sarah Asari Ekpenyong, were recognized for their work in community environmental initiatives, practical problem-solving and volunteer service.

stories.title: Secunderabad MP to cover exam fees for 4,741 students
stories.summary: Union Minister G Kishan Reddy will pay the Telangana SSC Board examination fees for 4,741 Class 10 students across 87 government schools in his constituency. The initiative is intended to encourage students to pursue their education and realize their potential.

stories.title: ASRB opens registration for 1,393 technical posts
stories.summary: The Agricultural Scientists Recruitment Board has begun the registration process for 1,393 Technician Assistant and Senior Technical Assistant positions. Interested candidates must apply online by December 17, 2026. A correction window for submitted applications will open on December 18.

stories.title: Xavier University and MSU-IIT rank as top performing schools
stories.summary: Xavier University placed first and Mindanao State University-Iligan Institute of Technology placed fourth among top performing schools in the November 2026 Chemical Engineers Licensure Examination. Two graduates from MSU-IIT also secured spots in the top ten list of individual performers.

stories.title: Umber founder secures 2 million dollars in seed funding
stories.summary: Shahnaz Khan, founder of Umber and an alumnus of the IIT Bombay-Washington University in St. Louis Executive MBA program, has raised 2 million dollars in seed capital. The funding for the digital asset startup was provided by Nimesh Vora of Warter Aviation.

stories.title: IIT Delhi startups explore UAE market
stories.summary: Seven deep-tech startups from the AIC IIT Delhi campus recently completed a two-day immersion program in Abu Dhabi. The visit included sessions at New York University Abu Dhabi and Khalifa University to provide entrepreneurs with insights into UAE healthcare regulations and sustainability priorities.

stories.title: UGC identifies 32 fake universities
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission has released a list of 32 institutions it classifies as fake, with 12 located in Delhi. The commission warns that degrees from these unauthorized institutions are not recognized for employment or further education, urging the public to verify credentials before enrolling.

stories.title: UGC Flags 32 Universities As Fake, Students Advised To Verify Before Admission - NDTV
UGC advises students to verify university credentials
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission has issued an advisory urging students and parents to verify institutional recognition before seeking admission. The regulator warned applicants not to rely solely on promotional campaigns or advertisements, as degrees from unapproved institutions are not valid for employment or higher education.

stories.title: UGC warns against relying on university advertisements
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission has issued an advisory asking the public to independently verify the recognition status of institutions through official regulatory websites. The commission stated that brochures, social media posts and institutional claims should not be the sole basis for making financial or academic commitments.

stories.title: Students Beware: UGC Releases State-Wise List of 32 Fake Universities - NDTV Profit
UGC flags 32 unrecognised universities
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission has issued a warning regarding 32 institutions operating as fake universities across 12 states and territories. The commission highlighted that these institutions lack the legal authority to award recognized degrees and advised students to check official status before committing to any program.

stories.title: UGC identifies 32 fake universities across India
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission has identified 32 fake universities operating across India, with 12 of those institutions located in Delhi. Despite ongoing warnings from the commission, the number of unrecognised entities has increased by 10 over the past year. The list remains available for public review.

stories.title: UGC updates list of unrecognised higher education institutions
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission has released an updated list of 32 fake universities, with 12 institutions based in Delhi. The commission has issued an advisory urging students to verify the accreditation status of any institute before seeking admission. The list serves as a formal reminder of institutional status.

stories.title: National Medical Commission investigates ragging allegations in Rajasthan
stories.summary: The National Medical Commission has ordered a response from a government medical college in Rajasthan following allegations of abuse by senior students. The regulator warned that simple denials without supporting evidence will not be accepted. The college has been given 24 hours to address the claims.

stories.title: Medical seats remain vacant despite high competition
stories.summary: Approximately 410 MBBS seats remained unfilled in deemed universities following the NEET-UG 2026 Special Stray Vacancy Round. While government medical college seats were fully occupied, vacancies persisted in private institutions across states including Tamil Nadu and Karnataka. High fees and equitable access remain points of ongoing discussion.

stories.title: ‘International students, where are you at?’: ASUC hosts forum on immigrant, undocumented student issues - Daily Cal
International students navigate Canadian social customs
stories.summary: Exchange students at Queen's University have reported experiencing cultural adjustments regarding local social interactions. Students from abroad noted that common Canadian expressions and the frequency of friendly exchanges with strangers were unexpected. The university experience continues to include lessons outside of the formal academic curriculum.

stories.title: From JEE Pressure to Playtime: IIT Madras Focuses on Student Well-Being Through New Courses - Shiksha.com
Delhi launches Ehsaas 2026 mental health policy
stories.summary: The Delhi government has introduced the Ehsaas 2026 Mental Health and Well-Being Policy for schools and higher education institutions. The initiative aims to increase awareness and encourage open dialogue among students, teachers, and parents. The policy is supported by four pillars intended to guide implementation across the region.

stories.title: NEP 2020 shifts focus toward multidisciplinary education
stories.summary: The National Education Policy 2020 is moving away from traditional academic silos by encouraging students to combine subjects across disciplines. The policy aims to provide greater flexibility and diverse skill sets for students who previously remained within rigid Commerce, Science, or Arts pathways. Choice is now a policy.

stories.title: Handbook outlines recommendations for inclusive classrooms
stories.summary: A new handbook titled Inclusion in Action provides recommendations for implementing the Right to Education, including increased community engagement and clearer pathways to higher education. The findings are based on observations and interviews conducted across nine private schools in Delhi. Inclusion remains a work in progress.

research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: This study proposes a methodological framework for the coordinated use of multiple large language models in academic research. Its central argument is that involving more models does not in itself guarantee more reliable results, what matters. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: HireWatch: Evaluating LLM Compliance with U.S. Employment Law Under Contextual Pressure
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) in hiring pipelines is growing, yet existing evaluations generally overlook their compliance with legal rules. To fill this gap, we introduce HireWatch, an evaluation that assesses whether LLMs comply. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
